facts.fact: AGT's taxpayer cadastre held 11,173,618 registered taxpayers in January 2024 (10,849,787 individuals, 323,831 collective), according to AGT data cited by Expansao.
Expansao reports the taxpayer number (NIF) has been the national ID (BI) number since October 2018, and AGT mass-registers individuals ex officio from civil ID records.
